From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>

Nick — thanks for sending this over and for the clear asks. I reviewed the draft and uploaded a consolidated MAP_v2.docx (attached) with three small edits: scope definition, SLA/uptime callout, and an explicit rollback window for the initial rollout. Answers inline below and proposed owners.

MSA redline format: Redwood legal prefers PDF with tracked changes + a Word file with comments for the contract team. If you return both we’ll ingest faster.
Order form vs quote: we can provide a formal order form that mirrors the quote line items. For procurement’s PO process, please share the PO contact and any internal PO template.

Proposed owners / immediate asks (for the weekly MAP checkpoint):
- MSA redline owner: Karthik Iyer (Redwood legal liaison) — deliver preliminary redline by 2026-11-22
- Order form review: Priya Natarajan — send draft order form to procurement@acmeretail.com by 2026-11-19
- Vendor setup (cloud account + SSO): Lauren Bishop (CS onboarding) — provide onboarding checklist and SSO SAML metadata by 2026-11-24

I’ve scheduled our weekly MAP checkpoint for Thursday 11/18 at 11:00 PT to walk through blockers — calendar invite sent.

Attachments: MAP_v2.docx (attached)

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Looping in legal status per Priya’s asks. Quick update from my side:

- MSA redlines: Redwood legal will return an annotated PDF and a Word with comments by EOD 2026-11-22 (we will call out any non-standard data residency language).
- Key commercial clarifications: minimum term and early-termination liability language need one more pass. I’ll flag recommended language in the redline.
- Order form: Priya, I reviewed the pricing rows and they look aligned to the quote. I recommend including a one-line SLA credit table in the order form to speed procurement approval.
- Vendor setup dependencies: Acme needs an AWS account number, an SSO contact, and the person who will accept the onboarding invite. Without those we cannot complete vendor provisioning.

Action items I own: produce redline by 11/22; escalate any data-residency exceptions by 11/19 EOD.

-Karthik

Thanks — adding the vendor onboarding checklist here so procurement has visibility. Short version below; I attached the full checklist as vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx.

Vendor onboarding checklist (summary):
- Cloud account (AWS account number) — required for provisioning
- SSO: SAML metadata or OIDC issuer + contact to accept invite
- Data access contacts: engineer who will own the KV cache keys and a Security contact for audit logs
- Billing/PO contact: procurement@acmeretail.com or named PO approver
- Test environment access: expected start date and sample workload for eval (token/day estimate)

If procurement can confirm AWS account number and PO contact, we’ll begin provisioning next week.

Attachment: vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
